name: Kelpie
description: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.
motivesTactics: Adopt an attractive or useful shape

abilities.name: Captivating
abilities.description: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Kelpie’s Melee range.

abilities.name: Heart’s Desire
abilities.description: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

abilities.name: Shapeshifter
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to change the Kelpie’s physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

abilities.name: Enchant
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Enchanted until they take damage. While Enchanted, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC’s most deeply held morals.
